Draw a blue-bordered (#0000ff) rectangle in the upper-left/center, about 65% slide width and 40% slide height, as the neural network container. Inside it: place 2 white (#ffffff) input circles labeled 'x1' on top and 'x2' on the bottom; place 2 white (#ffffff) hidden circles labeled 'S1' and 'S2' to the right of the inputs, each containing a sigma (Σ) symbol; draw 4 arrows with labels: x1->S1 '-1' in #ff0000, x1->S2 '1' in #0000ff, x2->S1 '1' in #ff0000, and x2->S2 '-1' in #0000ff. 5. Still inside the blue-bordered rectangle, place 2 purple-outlined step-function boxes to the right of S1 and S2; label the box to the right of S1 as 'Z1' and the box to the right of S2 as 'Z2'. Above Z1 place '>0.5 => 1' in #ffff00 and '<0.5 => 0' in #ff0000. Above Z2 place '>= -0.5 => 1' in #008000 and '< -0.5 => 0' in #ff0000. 6. Place 1 white (#ffffff) output circle labeled 'S3' with a sigma (Σ) symbol to the right of Z1 and Z2. Draw an arrow from Z1 to S3 labeled '-1' in #ff0000, and an arrow from Z2 to S3 labeled '1' in #008000. 7. Draw an arrow from S3 to a third purple-outlined step-function box labeled 'Z3'/'O/P'. Above that box place '>0 => 1' in #ffff00 and '<0 => 0' in #ff0000. Draw an outgoing arrow from the box labeled 'O/P'. 8. Place a red-bordered (#ff0000) truth table at the upper-right with 3 columns and 4 data rows. Headers: 'X1', 'X2', 'O/P'. Rows: '0','0','0','0','0','1','1','1' with the Z3 cell filled #00ffff; '0','1','-1','0','-1','0','0','0' with the Z3 cell filled #90ee90; '1','0','1','1','1','1','0','0' with the Z3 cell filled #90ee90; '1','1','0','0','0','1','1','1' with the Z3 cell filled #00ffff. Use black text on white cells. 10. Place a rounded callout box at the bottom-right with #ffffe0 fill and a thin border. Add 3 lines: 'Adding Non-Linearity' in #0000ff, 'Solves the' in #000000, and 'XOR Problem' with 'XOR' in #ff0000 and 'Problem' in #000000.
